dialogues.speaker: Ichca
dialogues.text: Hello, friend! Any plans to travel somewhere a bit "cooler" in the near future?

dialogues.speaker: Ichca
dialogues.text: For argument's sake, let's just assume you do want the thrill of a chill. In which case, you can't set out without something warm to wear, can you?

dialogues.speaker: Ichca
dialogues.text: You wouldn't be interested in trying out some Alpaca wool products, would you? They're finer, softer, and warmer than sheep wool!

dialogues.speaker: Ichca
dialogues.text: Come on, don't just brush me off...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like a hard sell here in Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Ichca
dialogues.text: I—I wouldn't say it's "impossible" to sell. It's just, uh... a niche market. Sorta.

dialogues.speaker: Ichca
dialogues.text: Normally, the Masters of the Night-Wind only use that wool for making blankets.

dialogues.speaker: Ichca
dialogues.text: But Alpacas themselves can be used in many ways. They can be ridden for transport and they also make great farming assistants.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Doesn't sound like you'd be in a hurry to sell them, then.

dialogues.speaker: Ichca
dialogues.text: No, wait a moment. This has nothing to do with being in a hurry.

dialogues.speaker: Ichca
dialogues.text: As a farmer raising Alpacas, isn't it perfectly natural that I'd want to show the world how great and versatile they are?

dialogues.speaker: Ichca
dialogues.text: Wouldn't it just be a tragedy if there were people out there, freezing their socks off in a world of ice and snow, yet who have never experienced the immeasurable bliss in clothing form that is their wool?

dialogues.speaker: Ichca
dialogues.text: So, my friend, if you run into anyone in need of some warm clothes, please be sure you put in a good word for Alpaca wool!
